ambiguity_notes: Spec says 'reset release is synchronous to clk' but reset itself is asynchronous; interpreted as: the reset de-assertion edge is not specially synchronized — normal metastability handling is assumed external to the module.
Spec does not specify dout value when shift_out_en is low or done is not asserted; assumed dout is driven to 0 in those cases.

Spec does not explicitly state whether the unload counter pauses when shift_out_en is deasserted mid-unload; assumed the counter pauses (holds) and resumes when shift_out_en is re-asserted, allowing non-contiguous unloading.
Spec says done 'clears on new load_en begins' but does not specify the exact cycle; assumed done clears on the first rising edge where load_en is sampled high after done is asserted.
Spec does not define FSM encoding style; assumed one_hot for area/timing balance on gf180mcuD, but this is an implementation detail not a functional requirement.
Spec does not specify behavior of dout during the load or encrypt phases; assumed dout is held at 0.

Spec does not specify what happens if load_en is deasserted before 144 bits are loaded; assumed the load counter freezes and the encrypt phase does not start until 144 bits have been received (load_en must be held for exactly 144 cycles).
Spec does not specify whether shift_out_en has any effect before done is asserted; assumed it is ignored.
The spec states the round counter XOR uses values 1..31 (i.e., the round index, not zero-based); assumed the counter is initialized to 1 at the start of encryption and increments each round.

Spec does not specify initial values of state and key_reg after reset; assumed they are cleared to zero on reset, though this does not affect functional correctness since they are fully overwritten during load.

behavior_invariants.condition: While load_en is asserted, on each rising edge of clk the internal shift register {key_reg[79:0], state[63:0]} shifts left by one bit and din is inserted at the LSB. The first 80 bits received become key_reg (key[79] arrives first), and the next 64 bits become state (plaintext[63] arrives first). An internal 8-bit load counter increments each cycle and reaches 144 when loading is complete.
behavior_invariants.description: During load phase, din is shifted MSB-first into {key_reg[79:0], state[63:0]} on each rising clock edge while load_en is high
behavior_invariants.name: load_phase_serial_shift

behavior_invariants.condition: When the load counter reaches 144 (the 144th rising edge with load_en high), the encrypt phase begins on that same cycle. No additional control signal is required to start encryption.
behavior_invariants.description: Encryption begins automatically on the cycle the 144th bit is shifted in, without any external trigger
behavior_invariants.name: encrypt_auto_start

behavior_invariants.condition: In each of the first 31 encrypt cycles, the core performs addRoundKey (XOR state with key_reg[79:16]), sBoxLayer (apply 4-bit S-box to each of the 16 nibbles of state), pLayer (apply the PRESENT bit permutation P(i)=(i*16) mod 63 for i in 0..62, P(63)=63), and then updates key_reg per the key schedule. On the 32nd encrypt cycle, only addRoundKey is performed using the 32nd round key. The round counter sequences from 1 to 31 and is XORed into key_reg[19:15] during each key schedule update.
behavior_invariants.description: Encryption executes exactly 31 full rounds followed by one final addRoundKey, completing in 32 clock cycles
behavior_invariants.name: encrypt_round_sequence

behavior_invariants.condition: The key schedule update consists of three steps applied in order: (1) rotate key_reg left by 61 bit positions (equivalently right by 19), (2) replace key_reg[79:76] with S[key_reg[79:76]] using the PRESENT S-box, (3) XOR the current round index i (ranging 1 to 31) into key_reg[19:15]. This update occurs after each of the 31 full rounds.
behavior_invariants.description: After each round, key_reg is rotated left by 61 bits, S-box applied to top nibble, and round counter XORed into bits [19:15]
behavior_invariants.name: key_schedule_rotation

behavior_invariants.condition: Before applying the key schedule update for round i, the value key_reg[79:16] (the top 64 bits) is used as the round key and XORed with state. The 32nd round key is key_reg[79:16] after the 31st key schedule update.
behavior_invariants.description: The round key used in addRoundKey is the 64 most-significant bits of key_reg before the key schedule update for that round
behavior_invariants.name: round_key_extraction

behavior_invariants.condition: done transitions from 0 to 1 on the clock edge following completion of the 32nd encrypt cycle. done remains asserted (1) until either rst_n is deasserted (goes low) or load_en is asserted to begin a new load sequence, whichever occurs first.
behavior_invariants.description: done is asserted exactly when the 32-cycle encryption phase completes and held high until reset or a new load begins
behavior_invariants.name: done_assertion

behavior_invariants.condition: On each rising edge of clk where both done and shift_out_en are asserted, the internal ciphertext register shifts left by one bit and the MSB is presented on dout. ciphertext[63] is output first. An internal 6-bit unload counter tracks how many bits have been shifted out; after 64 bits the unload is complete. dout is 0 when shift_out_en is low or done is not asserted.
behavior_invariants.description: While done is asserted and shift_out_en is high, ciphertext is shifted out MSB-first on dout, one bit per clock
behavior_invariants.name: unload_serial_shift

behavior_invariants.condition: Whenever rst_n is low (regardless of clk), done is immediately forced to 0, all counters (load, round, unload) are cleared, and the FSM returns to idle. The core does not resume any prior operation after reset release.
behavior_invariants.description: Asserting rst_n low asynchronously clears done and aborts any in-progress operation
behavior_invariants.name: reset_clears_done_and_state

behavior_invariants.condition: If load_en is asserted while done is 1, done is cleared to 0 on the next rising edge of clk and the load counter restarts from 0, beginning a new encryption operation.
behavior_invariants.description: Asserting load_en while done is high clears done and begins a new load sequence
behavior_invariants.name: new_load_clears_done

behavior_invariants.description: The S-box mapping must exactly match the PRESENT-80 specification
behavior_invariants.name: sbox_correctness

behavior_invariants.condition: Bit i of the pre-permutation state is placed at position P(i) of the post-permutation state, where P(i) = (i * 16) mod 63 for i in 0..62, and P(63) = 63. All 64 bits are permuted simultaneously.
behavior_invariants.description: The pLayer permutation must exactly match the PRESENT-80 specification
behavior_invariants.name: player_correctness

behavior_invariants.condition: Given key=0x00000000000000000000 and plaintext=0x0000000000000000, ciphertext must be 0x5579C1387B228445. Given key=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF and plaintext=0x0000000000000000, ciphertext must be 0xE72C46C0F5945049. Given key=0x00000000000000000000 and plaintext=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, ciphertext must be 0xA112FFC72F68417B. Given key=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF and plaintext=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, ciphertext must be 0x3333DCD3213210D2.
behavior_invariants.description: The module must produce correct ciphertext for all four specified PRESENT-80 test vectors
behavior_invariants.name: test_vector_compliance

behavior_invariants.condition: The Verilog implementation must not instantiate any sub-modules. S-box lookup, pLayer permutation, key schedule, FSM, and all counters must be implemented as inline logic within the present80 module boundary.
behavior_invariants.description: All logic must be inlined within the single present80 module with no sub-module instantiations
behavior_invariants.name: flat_module_constraint

clock_domains.name: clk
clock_domains.notes: Single clock domain; all flip-flops triggered on rising edge; target period 10 ns for gf180mcuD PDK

port_assumptions.notes: Rising-edge triggered, 100 MHz (10 ns period), single clock domain
Asynchronous active-low reset; release is synchronous to clk
Must be held high for exactly 144 consecutive rising edges to complete a load; asserting during done clears done and restarts
Serial input; sampled on rising edge of clk when load_en is high; key[79] arrives first, then key[78]..key[0], then plaintext[63]..plaintext[0]
Only effective when done is asserted; ignored otherwise; need not be held continuously — unload counter pauses when shift_out_en is low
MSB-first serial ciphertext output; ciphertext[63] is first bit shifted out; valid only when done and shift_out_en are both asserted
Asserted after 32 encrypt cycles complete; held until rst_n goes low or load_en is asserted
